postings.conferenceSeries: 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders
postings.conferenceText: Rome and Online, from June 24-26, 2027 - the 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders hosts the international neurology community for three days of scholarly programme. Formatted as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 24-26, 2027), the 13th Edition of International Conference on Neurology, Brain Health & Neurological Disorders (Neurology 2027) gives the international neurology community a working forum for scholarly briefings, clinical sessions, and case-based discussion. Every session is directed at supporting neurologists, neuroscience researchers, and clinical practitioners in refreshing their working knowledge. Coverage at this Neurodegenerative Diseases Conference 2027 reaches across Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, stroke management, neurodegenerative diseases, brain tumors and neuro-oncology, epilepsy and seizure disorders, AI in neurology, neuroimmunology, clinical neurology, neuropharmacology, cognitive and memory disorders, neurological interventions, pediatric neurology, neurological rehabilitation, neuroimaging, translational neurology, and trauma and neurocritical care. CPD certificates of attendance are provided to attending delegates and presenters; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Neurology Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. postings.conferenceSeries: 2nd Edition of International Conference on Environmental Science, Sustainability & Global Innovation
postings.conferenceText: Environmental science, sustainability, and climate research converge at the 2nd Edition of International Conference on Environmental Science, Sustainability & Global Innovation in Rome and Online from June 21-23, 2027, with sixteen tracks bridging research and real-world impact. Framed as a CPD-accredited three-day meeting at NH Villa Carpegna, Rome (June 21-23, 2027), the 2nd Edition of International Conference on Environmental Science, Sustainability & Global Innovation (EnviWorld 2027) gives the international environmental-science community a working forum for research briefings, methodology sessions, and case-based discussion. Every part of the programme is intended to bring research findings from laboratory and field into practice-ready knowledge for scientists, sustainability advisers, and public-sector professionals. Coverage at this Planetary Health Conference 2027 reaches across climate adaptation, biodiversity, renewable energy, AI-driven environmental intelligence, earth systems, air quality, oceanography, hydrology, environmental engineering, pollution control, planetary health, environmental policy and governance, environmental chemistry, soil and food security, remote sensing, and emerging environmental technologies. Delegates and presenters attending the conference each receive a CPD certificate of attendance; oral or poster abstracts that pass review add further academic recognition. Within the Environmental Science Conferences 2027 calendar, this meeting operates a tiered registration model - abstract submission for speakers and presenters, standard or early-bird rates for delegates and listeners. postings.conferenceName: International Conference on Green Chemistry and Renewable Energy (Green Chemistry 2027)
postings.conferenceSeries: International Conference on Green Chemistry and Renewable Energy
postings.conferenceText: NH Villa Carpegna welcomes the 7th Edition of International Conference on Green Chemistry and Renewable Energy (Green Chemistry 2027) from June 21-23, 2027, with a parallel virtual channel extending the meeting to attendees who cannot travel to Rome. Under the direction of Magnus Group LLC, the Green Chemistry Research Conference 2027 brings together sustainability chemists, renewable-energy researchers, environmental engineers, industrial R&D specialists, climate scientists, policymakers, and academic partners for three days of applied research, collaborative discussion, and forward-facing sessions on green chemistry and clean-energy science. The programme covers green synthesis, green catalysis, renewable-energy conversion and storage, hybrid renewable systems, waste-to-energy, bioremediation, circular-economy chemistry, bio-based materials, climate-change science, and AI applications in green chemistry - with sessions crafted to bridge fundamental research and real-world deployment. Researchers, engineers, and industry chemists are respectfully invited to share original findings, applied case studies, and mechanistic reviews through oral or poster presentations. Delegates and listeners may complete registration on the International Green Chemistry Conference 2027 portal to attend at NH Villa Carpegna or online from any country, with both options fully supported by the hybrid arrangement. postings.conferenceName: The International Conference on Cybertechnology and Future Networks (ICCFN) 2026
postings.conferenceText: The International Conference on Cybertechnology and Future Networks (ICCFN) is an outstanding opportunity to showcase research, products, and applications to an enthusiastic and engaged audience. It's a great way to reach hundreds of key decision-makers in cyber technology, business technology, innovation & entrepreneurship, and future networks. This year's conference will be held in a hybrid format, combining an in-person experience with a virtual component. The conference will be co-hosted with one of the premier European research forums (EUDAT). We anticipate that about 70% of participants will attend in person. The ICCFN is an outstanding opportunity to showcase research, products, and applications to an enthusiastic and engaged audience. ICCFN will invite thought leaders and discuss IoT advancements, 6G, the transformation of industries, smart cities, business, and cyber technologies. ICCFN will have the privilege of excellent researchers from around the world, representing magnificent top universities, who are presenting research and development studies at ICCFN. Their work will help to pave the way for the next generation of technologies. ICCFN will also invite global professional services companies that are providing consulting services on cybertechnology and future networks. The conference proceedings will be published by Springer Nature Link through their CCIS book series, which is fully indexed in DBLP, Google Scholar, EI-Compendex, Mathematical Reviews, SCImago, Scopus. Authors of selected papers will be invited to submit extended article versions to some special issues in the following well-reputed Springer journals: Discover IoT, Cluster Computing, and Discover Computing. Conference Website: https://cybertech.niu.edu/iccfn/index.php Paper Submission: https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/ICCFN2026/Submission/Index The organizing committee members are pleased to invite authors to submit original contributions to ICCFN 2026. All submissions will be peer-reviewed on the basis of relevance, originality, importance, and clarity. List of Topics All papers must be original and not simultaneously submitted to another journal or conference. postings.conferenceName: The 3rd International Symposium on Intelligent Technology for Future Transportation 2026
postings.conferenceText: The 3rd International Symposium on Intelligent Technology for Future Transportation (ITFT 2026) will be held in Glasgow, UK, from October 20-22, 2026 (hybrid). Following the successful editions of ITFT 2024 in Helsinki, Finland and ITFT 2025 in London, United Kingdom, this conference will continue to bring together distinguished scholars from around the world in the field of intelligent transportation to deliver keynote and invited speeches, as well as oral & poster presentations. The conference aims to continue the legacy of fostering innovation and collaboration in the field of intelligent transportation, and to create a smarter, greener, and more interconnected transportation landscape. T1：Intelligent Vehicle Technology and Applications T2：Intelligent Transportation Management T3：Advanced Technology for Public Transportation T4：Design and implementation of Intelligent Transportation Infrastructure T5：Other Intelligent Technology for Transportation

postings.conferenceText: Topics: smart health personalized healthcare health informatics healthcare digital twinsCall for One-Page AbstractsThe 2026 International Workshop on Digital Twins for Chronic Disease Monitoring and Personalized Healthcare will be held in conjunction with the IEEE EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026) on December 12, 2026, in Hong Kong.The workshop will explore healthcare digital twins for continuous monitoring, early detection, and personalized management of chronic diseases. postings.conferenceName: 2027 International Conference on System Safety and Security
postings.conferenceText: Topics: cybersecurity security training system safety engineering industrial practicesWe would like to invite you to participate in 2027 International Conference on System Safety and Security (ICSSS), which will be held at Georgia Southern University, Savannah, GA, USA from November 3-5, 2027.In the era of rapid advancements in information technology, artificial intelligence, and the Internet of Things, ensuring system safety and security has become a critical global priority. As modern systems, including industrial control, aerospace, and healthcare, become increasingly intelligent, they also face a growing array of security threats. The Rise of Autonomous and Learning Systems: The integration of AI and Machine Learning (ML) introduces a new paradigm where 'safety' is no longer just about avoiding failure, but ensuring Algorithmic Responsibility and robustness against adversarial manipulation. ICSSS recognizes that for these technologies to be trusted in critical infrastructure, they must be designed with transparency, fairness, and ethical oversight at their core. The Human and Educational Foundation: Beyond technical innovation, the sustainability of system safety depends on a skilled workforce. By integrating Security Pedagogy and Education into its core mission, ICSSS seeks to bridge the gap between academic research and the classroom. We aim to explore how modern instruction, from ethical hacking labs to AI-driven curriculum, can prepare the next generation of engineers and scholars to tackle evolving global risks.Submission Guidelines1. Papers should be written in English and limited to 4-10 pages.2. The authors of the paper will take responsibility for any Intellectual Property issues concerning the papers on their own.3. Accepted full papers will be invited for oral presentation at the conference and will be published in the conference proceedings.4. Papers accepted to be published into the conference proceedings must fully comply with the conference format for the final camera ready submission.5. Accepted abstracts will be invited for oral presentation at the conference, the presentation WILL NOT be published.List of TopicsDesign and analysis of safety‑critical systemsHazard identification, risk assessment, and safety analysisReliability, Maintainability, and Availability (RAM) analysisSafety certification, standards, and regulatory complianceResilient system architecturesRisk management frameworks and resilience engineeringEmergency response, disaster recovery, and business continuityHuman factors, safety culture, and organizational resilienceNetwork, system, and cloud securitySecurity protocols, cryptography, and identity managementThreat modeling, vulnerability assessment, and intrusion detectionSecurity of IoT, Cyber‑Physical Systems (CPS), and SCADA systemsIndustrial control systems and smart manufacturing securityEmbedded system safety and securityCritical infrastructure protection and operational technology (OT) security...PublicationSubmitted paper will be peer reviewed by conference committees, and accepted papers will be included in ICSSS 2027 Conference Proceedings.VenueGeorgia Southern University (Armstrong Campus Student Union)Address: 11935 Abercorn Street, Savannah, GA 31419ContactMail Address: icsss_conf@acamedic.netPhone Number：+001(559)-8624927
